explainability.interpretation: Exact contributions describe the fitted logistic computation in log-odds space. Permutation importance describes held-out predictive dependence. Neither establishes causal factors, learning, competence, or pedagogical effectiveness.

ordinal_levels.reason: Ordinal labels require a separate validation, error-cost, stability, and pedagogical review decision before implementation.

binary_alert.reason: A pedagogical alert requires an explicit decision threshold, error-cost analysis, calibration evidence, and human review workflow.

mandatory_warning: This profile summarizes held-out interaction evidence and contextual prediction probabilities. It is not a direct measure of mastery, competence, learning, diagnosis, causality, or pedagogical effectiveness.
